concepts.def: Inspecting finished goods to spot defects
Building quality into every stage of production
Cutting waste of all kinds to raise efficiency

% of units made that fail quality checks

walkthroughs.body_html:
QC = end-of-line inspection. QA = quality built in.

QA prevents defects (training, standard procedures); QC catches them. QA is cheaper long-term.

Lean cuts every kind of waste: time, materials, motion, defects, over-production.

Common techniques: JIT, continuous improvement (Kaizen), and cell production.

JIT: stock arrives just as needed. Low storage costs but vulnerable to supplier delays.

JIC: keep a buffer. Safer but ties up cash in inventory and risks waste.
